nodes.label: Person (single)
nodes.description: One human being is the subject of the shot, with nothing said yet about their age or gender. Pick a more specific child node when you know who is in frame.
examples: a single person standing in an empty room
portrait of one person against a plain wall

nodes.label: Adult woman
nodes.description: One adult woman is the subject of the shot.
examples: a woman walking down a city street
half-length portrait of a woman by a window

nodes.label: Adult man
nodes.description: One adult man is the subject of the shot.
examples: a man leaning against a parked car
half-length portrait of a man in a doorway

nodes.label: Young adult
nodes.description: A person who reads as roughly college age to late twenties: clearly past their teens, but still young.
examples: a young adult sitting on a skate ramp
nodes.prompt_fragment: a young adult in their twenties

nodes.label: Teenager
nodes.description: A person who reads as being roughly thirteen to nineteen years old.
examples: a teenager waiting at a bus stop with headphones on

nodes.label: Child
nodes.description: A young person, roughly pre-teen, as the subject of the shot.
examples: a child running across a park lawn

nodes.label: Elderly person
nodes.description: An older person as the subject of the shot, described respectfully and without any judgement about them.
examples: an elderly person seated on a park bench in soft light

nodes.label: Group of people
nodes.description: More than one person is in the frame. Choose a child node when you know roughly how many.
examples: a group of people talking on a street corner

nodes.label: Two people
nodes.description: Exactly two people share the frame, whatever their relationship is.
examples: two people facing each other across a cafe table

nodes.label: Couple
nodes.description: Two people shown together as a couple, usually close to each other or touching.
examples: a couple walking hand in hand along a wet pavement

nodes.label: Small group (three to six)
nodes.description: Roughly three to six people together, few enough that you can still see each of them clearly.
examples: a small group of friends sitting on a rooftop
nodes.prompt_fragment: a small group of three to six people

nodes.label: Crowd
nodes.description: So many people that they read as one mass rather than as individuals.
examples: a crowd flowing across a busy crossing at night

nodes.label: Animal
nodes.description: An animal is a subject of the shot. Choose a child node when you know which animal it is.

nodes.label: Dog
nodes.description: A dog is a subject of the shot, on its own or with a person.
examples: a person walking a dog through morning fog

nodes.label: Cat
nodes.description: A cat is a subject of the shot, on its own or with a person.
examples: a cat sitting on a windowsill in hard afternoon light

nodes.label: No people in frame
nodes.description: Nothing living is in the picture: the shot is of a place or a thing rather than of anyone.

nodes.label: Object only
nodes.description: A single object or small arrangement of objects is the whole subject, the way a still life or a product photo works.
examples: a coffee cup on a table lit by a window, nobody around
nodes.prompt_fragment: a single object as the only subject

nodes.label: Landscape only
nodes.description: A wide view of a place with no one in it, such as scenery, a skyline or an empty street.
examples: an empty mountain valley at first light
nodes.prompt_fragment: an empty landscape with no people

nodes.label: No distinct subject
nodes.description: Nothing in the frame is picked out as the subject at all: the image is a texture, a pattern or an empty space.
examples: a flat wall of peeling paint filling the whole frame
nodes.prompt_fragment: no distinct subject in the frame

nodes.label: Long hair
nodes.description: The hair falls well below the shoulders.
examples: long hair falling past the shoulders

nodes.label: Medium-length hair
nodes.description: The hair reaches roughly to the shoulders: neither short nor long.

nodes.label: Short hair
nodes.description: The hair is cut above the shoulders, roughly ear length or shorter.

nodes.label: Buzzed hair
nodes.description: The hair is clipped down to a few millimetres all over, like a buzz cut or a crew cut.

nodes.label: Bald
nodes.description: There is no hair on the head, either shaved smooth or naturally bald.

nodes.label: Straight hair
nodes.description: The hair falls in a straight line with no wave or curl in it.

nodes.label: Wavy hair
nodes.description: The hair has soft S-shaped waves rather than tight curls.

nodes.label: Curly hair
nodes.description: The hair grows in defined curls or ringlets.

nodes.label: Coily hair
nodes.description: The hair grows in very tight coils or a dense springy texture. This describes the hair itself only.

nodes.label: Black hair
nodes.description: The hair is black or so dark it reads as black.

nodes.label: Brown hair
nodes.description: The hair is some shade of brown, from light chestnut to near-black brown.

nodes.label: Blonde hair
nodes.description: The hair is light gold, honey or platinum in colour.

nodes.label: Red hair
nodes.description: The hair is red, copper, auburn or ginger.

nodes.label: Grey hair
nodes.description: The hair has gone grey, silver or white.

nodes.label: Vividly dyed hair
nodes.description: The hair is dyed a colour hair does not grow in naturally, such as pink, blue, green or lilac.

nodes.label: Ponytail
nodes.description: The hair is gathered and tied at the back or top of the head so it hangs in one tail.
nodes.negative_fragment: hair not tied in a ponytail

nodes.label: Bun
nodes.description: The hair is coiled and pinned into a round knot on the head.

nodes.label: Hair worn loose
nodes.description: The hair is left hanging free rather than tied up in any way.

nodes.label: Slicked-back hair
nodes.description: The hair is combed flat back from the face, usually with gel or water so it looks wet.

nodes.label: Braided hair
nodes.description: The hair is woven into one or more braids or plaits.

nodes.label: Bangs (fringe)
nodes.description: A section of hair is cut short at the front so it falls across the forehead.

nodes.label: Bob cut
nodes.description: A cut that ends level around the chin or jaw, the same length all the way round.

nodes.label: Fair skin tone
nodes.description: The skin reads as very light in the picture. This taxonomy describes only how the skin looks in the picture; it deliberately carries no ethnicity, race or nationality categories.

nodes.label: Light skin tone
nodes.description: The skin reads as light in the picture, a step deeper than fair. This taxonomy describes only how the skin looks in the picture; it deliberately carries no ethnicity, race or nationality categories.

nodes.label: Medium skin tone
nodes.description: The skin reads as mid-toned in the picture, between light and deep. This taxonomy describes only how the skin looks in the picture; it deliberately carries no ethnicity, race or nationality categories.

nodes.label: Tan skin tone
nodes.description: The skin reads as warm and sun-tanned in the picture. This taxonomy describes only how the skin looks in the picture; it deliberately carries no ethnicity, race or nationality categories.

nodes.label: Deep skin tone
nodes.description: The skin reads as deep-toned in the picture. This taxonomy describes only how the skin looks in the picture; it deliberately carries no ethnicity, race or nationality categories.

nodes.label: Freckles
nodes.description: Small natural spots of darker pigment scattered across the face or shoulders.

nodes.label: Slim build
nodes.description: The body reads as narrow and light in build.

nodes.label: Average build
nodes.description: The body reads as neither notably slim nor notably heavy: an ordinary build.

nodes.label: Athletic build
nodes.description: The body reads as trained and toned, the way an athlete looks.

nodes.label: Muscular build
nodes.description: The body reads as visibly heavily muscled.

nodes.label: Curvy figure
nodes.description: The body reads with pronounced curves through the waist and hips.

nodes.label: Larger build
nodes.description: The body reads as fuller and larger in build. Described plainly and without judgement.

nodes.label: Tall (impression)
nodes.description: The person gives the impression of being tall. This is only an impression from the picture, never a measurement.

nodes.label: Average height (impression)
nodes.description: The person gives no particular impression of being tall or short.

nodes.label: Short (impression)
nodes.description: The person gives the impression of being short or petite. This is only an impression from the picture, never a measurement.

nodes.label: Wearing makeup
nodes.description: Makeup is visible on the face. Choose a child node when you know how strong it is.

nodes.label: Natural makeup
nodes.description: Makeup so soft it barely reads as makeup at all: even skin, a little colour, nothing dramatic.

nodes.label: Bold makeup
nodes.description: Strong, obvious makeup such as a dark eye, a sharp liner or a deep lip colour.

nodes.label: Editorial makeup
nodes.description: Makeup used as a design element rather than as flattery, the way a fashion magazine shoot uses it.
nodes.prompt_fragment: editorial makeup with a graphic finish

nodes.label: No visible makeup
nodes.description: The face is bare, with no makeup visible on it.

nodes.label: Beard
nodes.description: Hair grown on the jaw and chin. Choose a child node when you know how long or what shape it is.

nodes.label: Stubble
nodes.description: A day or two of beard growth, short enough to read as shadow rather than as a beard.

nodes.label: Full beard
nodes.description: A thick beard covering the jaw and chin, clearly longer than stubble.

nodes.label: Goatee
nodes.description: Beard hair kept only on the chin, with the cheeks shaved.

nodes.label: Moustache
nodes.description: Hair grown on the upper lip only.

nodes.label: Clean-shaven
nodes.description: There is no facial hair at all: the face is freshly shaved.

nodes.label: Eyewear
nodes.description: Something is worn over the eyes. Choose a child node for clear glasses or for sunglasses.

nodes.label: Eyeglasses
nodes.description: Clear prescription-style glasses through which the eyes stay visible.

nodes.label: Sunglasses
nodes.description: Tinted glasses that hide the eyes.

nodes.label: Visible tattoos
nodes.description: Tattooed ink is visible on the skin somewhere in frame.

nodes.label: Sleeve tattoo
nodes.description: Tattoos cover most of an arm, from shoulder to wrist or to the elbow.
nodes.prompt_fragment: a full tattoo sleeve down the arm

nodes.label: Small tattoo
nodes.description: One small, delicate tattoo rather than large coverage.

nodes.label: Piercings
nodes.description: Jewellery worn through a piercing in the ear, nose, brow or lip.
